_comment: Browser launch profile for all Playwright MCP browser skills (zehrs-grocery, used-car-search, rbc-banking).
Do NOT add JS 'stealth' init scripts here. Patching navigator.webdriver / navigator.plugins from
an init script is itself a detection signal — Akamai Bot Manager blocks on it (verified: real Chrome
+ JS patch = 403, real Chrome + native flags below = 200 on zehrs.ca).
Automation must be suppressed natively via ignoreDefaultArgs + disable-blink-features, not in JS.
